tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit with normal MCV, MCH, MCHC), suggesting possible chronic disease or early anemia. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is markedly elevated, indicating increased platelet size variability, which may reflect reactive or regenerative changes. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further clinical correlation and investigation of anemia etiology are recommended.
